dream_report_en: I somehow still had a picture in my mind, duck feet as stickers, no people or places. It's definitely at [U-Bahn station], where you go up from the U-Bahn to the S-Bahn, where the woman, I don't know if you know her, the woman [name] is her name, is lying around on the stairs or standing around and somehow I... yeah, now I remember, it was a meeting, we have this center for teacher training, whatever we were discussing, somehow I said I had to leave early because I still had to catch my S-Bahn, but the teacher training center was at the [subway station] on the mezzanine floor, where the [bakery] is. Um, I somehow walked up there and missed the S-Bahn, then I went back but the session was already over by then. I only know that I was at a different place beforehand, with a club in front of me, and I think I went there with my friend, who was driving, by car, to go to this meeting at the Center for Teacher Education, which I think I was late for. But the car looked more like a Batmobile, somehow, like a black car with huge exhaust pipes on it, there was something with special boxes to take with you and it was all kind of like spotlights on the scenes, ... I have no idea where the duck feet came from. So what I can still see visually is this meeting room; it was a square room, a typical university room but a rather small room; the tables were arranged in a U or L shape with hooks, there was a pile of total chaos, there were folders and jackets and everything in a huge pile... and [name of friend] was also there, she's a person I trust, um, I think I talked to her a bit too, although part of it was also the meeting, but I didn't really notice the people there; but I don't know what was discussed there either, it was more that I tried to catch the S-Bahn, but it was gone. And Mr. [name] said that everything was planned on a very tight schedule, and then I wanted to help clean up.
